segments.text:
V. 37.
All that the Father giveth me—All that ſeel themſelves loſt, and follow the Drawings of the Father, He in a peculiar Manner giveth to the Son: Will come to me—By Faith. And him that thus cometh to me, I will in no wiſe caſt out—I will give him Pardon, Holineſs, and Heaven, if he endure to the End to rejoice in his Light.
